top_signals.title: Saudi Aramco Headquarters Hit as Houthi Attacks Escalate
top_signals.summary: Saudi Aramco’s administrative building in Dharan, eastern Saudi Arabia, was hit in attacks by the Iran-aligned Houthis on Tuesday night and Wednesday morning, amid an escalation of the Saudi-Houthi standoff in recent days. Limited fire was reported at Aramco’s headquarters as Saudi Arabia continued to intercept and destroy missiles towards Dharan and the capital Riyadh.     A ballistic missile launched by the Houthi militias toward Dhahran city was intercepted and destroyed, Major General Turki Al-Malki, Official Spokesperson…
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Two Power Bills Show Growing US Electricity Price Divide
top_signals.summary: The two neighbors weather the same storms, heat waves and cold snaps and live so close that each could probably spot the other’s house if they knew where to look. Michelle Ma and Nadja Popovich report on why prices are rising much faster at investor-owned utilities than at municipal ones. (Source: Bloomberg)

top_signals.title: NFL tickets discounted to fill Wembley Stadium
top_signals.summary: A 90,000-strong Wembley Stadium crowd for this weekend’s NFL fixture is under threat, prompting ticket discounts in areas of the London stadium. The fixture between the Jacksonville Jaguars and Houston Texans has not yet sold out, after a struggle to shift tickets for the first of three NFL matches – at the Tottenham Hotspur Stadium [...]
